notes: Depot print: the this-way-up arrows, the label bars, the stencil block, and the lid seam. Dark warm brown rather than black — ART_BIBLE 2 forbids a neutral anywhere, and a true black stencil would be the only crushed value in a frame whose whole palette is lifted. This is nonetheless the darkest surface on the vehicle after the eyes, and that is deliberate: without a value anchor the kart floats entirely in the top half of the range against the meadow, which is what made it read as pasted on. The brush is almost off; printed ink has no fibre of its own, it sits on the board's.
